mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tCodConstrVal ( ConstrCode, ConstrVal, ConstrValDesc, DefaltYn, ConstrValSeq, State, Remark, RegistDate, RegistId, RegistName ) VALUES ( #{constrCode}, #{constrVal}, #{constrValDesc}, #{defaltYn}, #{constrValSeq}, #{state}, #{remark}, NOW(), #{registId}, #{registName} )
mapper.update: UPDATE tCodConstrVal SET ConstrValDesc = #{constrValDesc}, DefaltYn = #{defaltYn}, ConstrValSeq = #{constrValSeq}, State = #{state}, Remark = #{remark}, ChangeDate = NOW(), ChangeId = #{changeId}, ChangeName = #{changeName} WHERE ConstrCode = #{constrCode} AND ConstrVal = #{constrVal}
